hints.tr: `LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date)` aynı müşterinin bir önceki sipariş tarihini getiriyor; ilk siparişte `NULL`.
hints.en: `LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date)` brings the same customer's previous order date; on the first order it is `NULL`.

hints.tr: Gün farkı onuncu bölümdeki gibi: `DATEDIFF(day, önceki, order_date)`. Önceki `NULL` ise sonuç da `NULL` — istenen de bu.
hints.en: The gap in days works as in the tenth section: `DATEDIFF(day, previous, order_date)`. If the previous one is `NULL`, so is the result — which is what we want.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
SELECT customer_id, id, order_date,
       DATEDIFF(day,
                LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id
                                      ORDER BY order_date),
                order_date) AS gap_days
FROM orders
ORDER BY customer_id, order_date;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
SELECT customer_id, id, order_date,
       DATEDIFF(day,
                LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id
                                      ORDER BY order_date),
                order_date) AS gap_days
FROM orders
ORDER BY customer_id, order_date;
```

hint.en: `LAG(order_date) OVER (...)` brings the previous row's value.
